name: Saint Anne of the Sunset
note: church() kit, sf/churches-3.ts: active Catholic parish, textbook nave/aisle/apse/tower plan per the escalation note (45 vertices); no reference photo, so built plainly from that description alone. Escalated from batch 4 on FORM.

name: Saint Ignatius Roman Catholic Church
note: sf/st-ignatius.ts (campus audit 2026-10-05, Commons photos of the front and the west flank): twin octagonal-staged towers with domed caps, giant front colonnade, clerestory nave, the ribbed grey dome at the north end. Was the church() kit's one-spire guess.

name: Saint Joseph's Arts Society
note: church() kit, sf/churches-3.ts: now secular, built as its unaltered former self, the Roman Catholic Saint Joseph's Church (old_name), per docs/shots/refs/batch5/way-160163535.jpg/-2.jpg: cream stucco, domed octagonal bell tower, round-arched windows, pediment front. OSM's 47 m tag is far taller than the photograph shows, so corrected down to a plainer nave ridge per the escalation brief's own rule (believe the reference). church()'s stucco roof colour is a fixed terracotta-brown with no gold option, so the dome renders brown rather than the photo's gilded gold -- a noted kit gap, not worked around. Escalated from batch 4 on FORM.

name: Macang Monastery
note: church() kit, sf/churches-3.ts: old_name 'Old Saint Patricks Church', now a Buddhist monastery, built as its former Catholic-church shape per docs/shots/refs/batch5/way-261273676.jpg (its -2.jpg sibling shows an unrelated building and is unused): twin octagonal bell towers with open lantern stages, tan sandstone classical front, oculus windows. Escalated from batch 4 on FORM.

name: Hua Zang Si
note: hua-zang-si.ts: the 1890s Gothic church painted red with grey trim — twin spired towers, rose window, Gothic portal up its steps (owner's Street View photograph, 2026-10-04); was the bake's brick box.
